notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.05.29.1:

- Added admin-initiated password reset in User Management (admin sets a new password; the user's open sessions are revoked).
- Added self-service "Change password" in the account security panel.
- Added 15-minute inactivity auto-logout with a sign-in notice.
- Removed the build-version chip from the navigation rail.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
